hypothesis: H4: a lineage of short-lived agents, each distilling its top episodes to a fresh plastic student through a narrow advice bottleneck, ratchets past weight-copy transfer and past single long lives with decaying plasticity.

config.eval_protocol: One deterministic greedy rollout per generation boundary (eps=0, np.argmax with lowest-index tie-break; env deterministic, so repeated rollouts collapse to a single support point). This is a fixed-tie-break proxy for the agent's own randomized-tie greedy policy: per-seed 0.0 finals mean the argmax policy loops, not necessarily every greedy realization. Eval consumes no training budget, draws no agent rng, and is byte-identical across conditions.

big_goal.stat_note: binary metric: plot the mean field (P(big goal)); the iqm field is a trimmed proportion of a 0/1 variable and overstates success rate

tests.correction: holm-bonferroni within each family (primary m=7, robustness m=7), applied to MW and Welch separately
tests.decision_rule: registered significance requires BOTH the Holm-adjusted Mann-Whitney AND Holm-adjusted Welch p below alpha

Distill vs weight-copy: IQM 0.00 vs 0.30 (means 0.00 vs 0.30), MW p=0.194 (Holm 1), Welch p=0 (Holm 0). Goal consolidated in 0/2 vs 0/2 lineages: full Q inheritance hands the student trap-shaped values with fresh schedules and never consolidates the goal.

claims.claim: plasticity decay is what strands the long life
claims.evidence: Rescue test: constant-eps-life (eps fixed 0.4 forever, lr decaying as usual) vs one-long-life: IQM 0.30 vs 0.30 (means 0.30 vs 0.30), MW p=1 (Holm 1), Welch p=1 (Holm 1) [comparison verdict null; a null RESCUE is registered as refuting the claim — undying exploration failing to un-strand the long life means exploration decay was not the binding constraint]. Final goal counts: constant-eps-life 0/2, one-long-life 0/2, one-long-life-slow 0/2. Caveat: lr still decays in this arm; but weight-copy (fully fresh schedules, inherited values) and one-long-life-slow (5x slower decay of both) locate the strand in consolidated trap values rather than lost plasticity.
